verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents shell execution, code interpreters, files, sessions, preview URLs, bucket mounts and outbound HTTP interception. Nothing shows that Cloudflare Sandboxes can register or connect to MCP servers and use their tools. Sandbox platforms could plausibly ship MCP integration, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
